_setup: Auth.Primary uses OAuth2 (preferred). Auth.Fallback uses BasicAuth if OAuth2 is unavailable.
1. Go to https://developer.atlassian.com/console/myapps/ and open your app (e.g. EntraID-API-Tickets).
2. Under Settings, copy the Client ID and Client Secret — store the secret in Azure Key Vault.
3. Call GET https://<your-site>.atlassian.net/_edge/tenant_info to get your CloudId.
4. Fill in Auth.Primary.ClientId and CloudId below; reference the secret from Key Vault at runtime.
1. Log in to Jira as the service/automation account.
2. Go to https://id.atlassian.com/manage-profile/security/api-tokens and create a token.
3. Fill in Auth.Fallback.UserEmail; store the token in Azure Key Vault.
